email.subject: Data Platform Engineer at Brightmoor Tech
email.body:
Hi,

I'm Sofia, a technical recruiter at Brightmoor Tech. I came across your profile and thought you might be interested in our Data Platform Engineer opening. You'd be working on our streaming data platform with a team of six engineers.

Is this something you'd like to explore? I'd be happy to share the job description and salary range.

Kind regards,
Sofia Lindqvist
